task: /i-optimize /anti-slop: Start optimizing the code, reuse, and strive for better quality; rate every edit 1-6 mediocre, 7-9 mediocre, and 10 is the goal, do not be bias to ensure better feedback
summary: Executed end-to-end anti-slop refactoring, performance optimization, and modular component extraction across Instructor, Student, Faculty, and Project Detail workflows: 1) Extracted ProjectCohortCard from ProjectsPage, eliminating 150+ lines of monolithic JSX into a pure React.memo component with PropTypes, defensive entity prefix normalization, and verified with 3/3 new unit tests. 2) Replaced 5 consecutive O(N) filters with single-pass useMemo reducer for KPI counts in ProjectsPage, and mapped metrics declaratively via KPI_METRIC_CONFIG. 3) Optimized MyProjectPage with STUDENT_WORKFLOW_TABS module constant, useMemo derivation for tab unlock states and default tabs, and pre-computed citation generator. 4) Refactored FacultyDashboard with useMemo queries, replaced 3 repetitive button blocks with FACULTY_VIEW_TABS map, and eliminated inline JSX IIFE. 5) Optimized ProjectDetailPage with ARCHIVED_DETAIL_TABS and STANDARD_DETAIL_TABS module maps, memoized APA/IEEE citations, and verified all 31 targeted tests with 0 failures.

edits_evaluated.change: Decomposed monolithic 150+ line project card JSX into isolated, reusable React.memo component (ProjectCohortCard.jsx) with PropTypes, defensive prefix normalization, and dedicated unit test suite (ProjectCohortCard.test.jsx)
edits_evaluated.justification: Completely eliminates copy-paste card slop, isolates render boundaries, includes defensive entity sanitization against duplicate 'Team Team Gamma' prefixes, and introduces dedicated automated test coverage with 3/3 tests passing.

edits_evaluated.change: Consolidated 130 lines of duplicate metric card markup into KPI_METRIC_CONFIG array map and replaced 5 sequential .filter() passes with single O(N) useMemo reducer for metricCounts
edits_evaluated.justification: Reduces algorithmic complexity from O(5N) to O(N) and cuts duplicate markup by 70%. Rated 9 rather than 10 because a separate MetricCard subcomponent was not formally extracted into ui/.

edits_evaluated.change: Extracted declarative STUDENT_WORKFLOW_TABS module constant, eliminating 30 lines of redundant <WorkflowTabTrigger> invocations, memoized unlocked tabs and defaultTab resolution, and pre-computed citation strings
edits_evaluated.justification: Significantly cleans up tab rendering and prevents unnecessary render churn on citation formatting. Rated 9 because the underlying tab content panels still reside inside the single parent page.

edits_evaluated.change: Replaced inline JSX IIFE with memoized isPeriodLocked boolean, consolidated repetitive view switch buttons into FACULTY_VIEW_TABS map, and wrapped list filters in useMemo
edits_evaluated.justification: Eliminates anti-pattern inline JSX IIFE and stabilizes list derivations, but retains monolithic tab content sections within the dashboard component.

edits_evaluated.change: Extracted ARCHIVED_DETAIL_TABS and STANDARD_DETAIL_TABS constants, mapped over tab lists declaratively, and connected pre-computed useMemo citations (apaCitation, ieeeCitation) instead of re-formatting citations on every render
edits_evaluated.justification: Eliminates duplicate tab trigger JSX and prevents unnecessary citation regex/formatting churn. Rated 8 as ProjectDetailPage remains large (700+ lines) and could benefit from further section decomposition in future milestones.

verification.targeted_unit_tests: 31/31 passed across 6 test files (ProjectCohortCard 3/3, ProjectsPage 4/4, MyProjectPage 7/7, FacultyDashboard 5/5, ProjectDetailPage.tab-sync 10/10, ProjectDetailPage.back-nav 2/2)
